locator.section: RG115a full Father-directed ending; accented full stem through Deus; four-word terminal with separate R.Amen

entries.claim: RG115a supplies the full Father-directed Per Dominum ending w026–w046 and Amen w047. The same-edition accented stem and terminal-response typography control accents and the separate response. This does not claim that the proper face prints the whole composite or establish every member’s conclusion in a larger group.

The priest says the Secret quietly through its conclusion; only the last Secret's Per omnia saecula saeculorum is audible or sung. In the bounded sole separately concluded commemoration context both Mass and commemoration endings are retained. No general per-member conclusion claim for larger groups is made.
